name: Hisayama (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Hisayama town emblem in white: a disc with a comma-shaped notch and a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Hisayama, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 July 1970.

features.role: Hisayama town emblem — a disc with a comma-shaped notch and a small disc
